The information architecture was structured to reduce cognitive load while maintaining depth. Categories were grouped logically to help users find products quickly without overwhelming choices.<br/>

The architecture focused on<br/>

Creating a clear and predictable navigation structure to reduce cognitive load \ Prioritizing product discovery
with logical category grouping \ Maintaining a shallow hierarchy to minimize the number of steps to key products

checkout flows clearly \ Ensuring consistent category naming aligned with user expectations

disputes with clarity, speed, and automation. The platform provides a comprehensive suite of tools to

create a modern, intuitive interface that simplifies complex financial processes while empowering

expertise with smart automation to eliminate friction and improve operational efficiency.
